summary: M0 model-only verdict: CONTAIN @ 0.95. Confirmed account takeover. Chain: phishing email delivered from lookalike domain aegean-edu.co (06:12), user clicked the verification link (06:15), then MFA fatigue attack from BulwarkHost Ltd Amsterdam IP 185.220.101.7 — seven MFA denials followed by an approval and a successful mail login (06:52–06:59) with no enrolled device, then rapid "sis" auth abuse from the same hosting IP. At 07:03 an inbox forwarding rule was created via API to exfiltrate mail to d.yilmaz.payroll@gmail.com. All of this deviates sharply from the user's normal Turkcell Manisa LT-2207 pattern (MFA prompt count 0). Credentials phished, MFA bypassed, mail accessed, exfiltration rule set = confirmed takeover requiring immediate containment (disable account, reset password, revoke sessions/MFA, remove forwarding rule).
limitations: M0 ablation: Nemotron alone, no tools, no Critic, no Risk Gate, no DQ. Not a product configuration.
